correctness.rationale: Every full 11 rung propagates to all-active by the 0-or-3 best response. Otherwise rung symbols 0,U,D are constrained by exact local three-neighbor responses: each zero-to-zero gap has length 2 or 3, a length-2 gap reverses next layer and length-3 preserves it. Cyclic consistency requires an even number of 2-gaps. Counting marked zeros yields the 2n/(q+r) binomial factor. Signed logarithmic generating functions give (6z^3+4z^4-6z^6)/(1-2z^3-z^4+z^6); primitive six-state transfer matrix and simple Perron root rho of x^3-x-1 give N_n~rho^n. Only n=5 lacks n=4a+3b representation for n>=3. The proof covers all integer n>=3; finite enumeration is corroboration.
